privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Learn how Souviks collects, uses, stores, shares and protects personal information when you use our website, create an account, submit an enquiry, request a quotation, place an order or otherwise interact with our services.

information.p1: Souviks may collect personal information that you provide directly when you use our website, contact us, create or manage an account, submit a part enquiry or quotation request, place an order, communicate with customer support, or participate in other website activities.
information.p2: The information collected depends on the services you use and may include information reasonably necessary to identify you, communicate with you, process an order, deliver products, provide support, maintain records and meet applicable legal requirements.
information.p3: We may also collect certain technical and usage information automatically when you access or use the website.
information.li1: Name and contact information, including phone number, mobile number and email address.
information.li2: Billing, shipping and delivery address information.
information.li3: Business information such as company name, GSTIN and related details where provided.
information.li4: Account information, including login credentials, saved preferences and account activity.
information.li5: Order, enquiry, quotation, invoice, return, refund and customer-support information.
information.li6: Technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information, operating-system information, approximate location information and website usage information.

purposes.p1: Souviks processes personal information for specific, lawful and reasonably necessary purposes connected with operating our business and providing the services requested by customers.
purposes.li1: Creating, authenticating and managing customer accounts.
purposes.li2: Responding to enquiries, part requests, quotation requests and customer-support requests.
purposes.li3: Processing orders, invoices, payments, refunds, exchanges and warranty-related requests.
purposes.li4: Arranging shipping, delivery, shipment tracking and communications with logistics providers.
purposes.li5: Maintaining business, tax, accounting, transaction and customer-service records.
purposes.li6: Preventing fraud, abuse, unauthorised activity and security incidents.
purposes.li7: Complying with applicable laws, regulatory requirements, legal process and lawful requests from authorities.

legal_basis.p1: Where applicable data-protection law requires a particular legal basis or notice, Souviks will process personal information on the basis applicable to the relevant processing activity. Depending on the circumstances, this may include consent, processing necessary for a requested service or transaction, compliance with a legal obligation, or another basis recognised by applicable law.
legal_basis.p2: Where processing is based on consent, Souviks will provide the required notice and request consent in an appropriate manner. Where applicable law provides a right to withdraw consent, the withdrawal process and any resulting effects will be handled in accordance with that law.

sharing.p1: Souviks does not sell personal information as a commercial commodity. We may disclose or share personal information where reasonably necessary to provide services, complete transactions, protect our systems and business, or comply with applicable law.
sharing.li1: Payment gateways, banks and authorised payment-service providers.
sharing.li3: Hosting, technology, communications, security, analytics and customer-support service providers.
sharing.li4: Professional advisers, auditors, insurers and other service providers where reasonably necessary for business or legal purposes.
sharing.li5: Government authorities, regulators, courts, law-enforcement agencies or other recipients where disclosure is required or permitted by applicable law.
sharing.p2: Depending on the service, certain third parties may process information on our behalf, while others may process information under their own lawful responsibilities. Their own terms and privacy policies may also apply.

payment.p1: Souviks may provide payment options including UPI, cash, bank transfer, cash on delivery, net banking and credit or debit cards, subject to the options available for a particular order.
payment.p2: Where payment is processed through a third-party payment provider, sensitive payment credentials may be handled directly by that provider. Souviks will receive and retain only information reasonably necessary for order processing, reconciliation, refunds, customer support, fraud prevention and applicable legal or accounting requirements.

delivery.p1: To fulfil an order, Souviks may provide the customer's name, telephone number, delivery address, order details and other necessary shipment information to the logistics provider responsible for delivery.
delivery.p2: The delivery provider may vary depending on destination, package characteristics, service availability, cost, delivery requirements and other operational considerations.

cookies.p1: Souviks may use cookies, local storage and similar technologies to operate the website, maintain sessions, remember preferences, improve performance, understand website usage and support security.
cookies.p2: Where applicable, optional technologies may be controlled through available cookie or privacy settings. Third-party services integrated into the website may also use cookies or similar technologies subject to their own policies and applicable requirements.
cookies.li1: Essential technologies required for core website functions, account sessions and security.
cookies.li2: Preference technologies used to remember language, settings or other choices.
cookies.li3: Analytics or performance technologies used, where enabled, to understand website usage and improve services.

retention.p1: Souviks retains personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including providing services, completing transactions, maintaining business and tax records, resolving disputes, preventing fraud, enforcing agreements and complying with applicable legal or regulatory obligations.
retention.p2: Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information, the reason for processing and applicable legal requirements. When information is no longer required and there is no lawful reason to retain it, Souviks will take reasonable steps to delete, anonymise or securely dispose of it.

security.p1: Souviks maintains reasonable technical and organisational security measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorised access, misuse, loss, alteration, destruction or disclosure.
security.p2: No internet transmission, website or information-storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Customers are responsible for protecting their account credentials and should notify Souviks promptly if they suspect unauthorised access or a security incident.

rights.p1: Subject to applicable data-protection law and any conditions or limitations imposed by that law, individuals may have rights concerning their personal information.
rights.li1: Request information about personal data processed by Souviks.
rights.li2: Request correction or updating of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
rights.li3: Request deletion or other action where such a right is provided by applicable law.
rights.li4: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, where and to the extent applicable law provides such a right.
rights.li5: Raise a complaint or grievance regarding the handling of personal information.
rights.p2: Requests may require reasonable identity verification. Souviks may refuse, restrict or defer a request where permitted or required by applicable law, including where retention is necessary for legal, security, fraud-prevention or dispute-resolution purposes.

children.p1: Souviks does not knowingly seek to process children's personal data except where such processing is permitted and carried out in accordance with applicable law and any required safeguards. If we become aware of processing that does not meet applicable requirements, we will take appropriate steps as required by law.

changes.p1: Souviks may update this Privacy Policy when our website, services, data-processing practices or applicable legal requirements change.
changes.p2: The updated Privacy Policy will be published on this page with its effective date. Where applicable law requires additional notice for a material change, Souviks will provide that notice through an appropriate channel.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This Refund Policy explains when a refund may be available, how refund requests are reviewed, and how approved refunds are processed by Souviks.

sections.eligibility: When a Refund May Be Available

overview.p1: Souviks processes refunds only in accordance with the applicable order terms, Exchange & Return Policy, product-specific conditions and applicable law.
overview.p2: Where a refund is approved, it will generally be processed only after the relevant product has been received and inspected, unless the circumstances or applicable law require otherwise.

eligibility.p1: A refund may be available where an eligible product is received damaged, is confirmed to have a manufacturing defect, or where Souviks is otherwise required to provide a refund under the applicable order terms or law.
eligibility.li1: Visible damage at delivery must be reported within 1 hour of delivery.
eligibility.li2: Eligible return or exchange requests generally must be raised within 7 days of delivery.
eligibility.li3: The product must satisfy the applicable return and inspection conditions.
eligibility.li4: The refund request must be approved by Souviks after verification, except where applicable law provides otherwise.

request.p1: To request a refund, contact Souviks using the customer-support details provided on this page and provide the order or invoice number, customer details, product information and reason for the request.
request.p2: Souviks may request photographs, videos, packaging details, product markings or other information reasonably necessary to assess the claim.

inspection.p1: Refund claims may require the affected product to be returned to Souviks for inspection and verification.
inspection.p2: The inspection may consider the product condition, packaging, seals, identifying markings, evidence of installation or use, and the nature and cause of the reported damage or defect.

approval.p1: A refund is not automatically approved merely because a request has been submitted. Souviks will assess the claim against the applicable policy and circumstances.
approval.li2: Approved for replacement or exchange instead of refund, where appropriate and legally permitted.
approval.li3: Rejected where the claim does not meet the applicable policy or where the product has been damaged, altered or used in a manner that excludes the claim, subject to applicable law.

processing.p1: For an approved return-based refund, Souviks will process the refund after the returned product has been received and inspected, unless a different process is required by applicable law or agreed for the particular transaction.
processing.p2: After Souviks initiates the refund, the time required for the amount to appear in the customer's account may depend on the payment method, bank, card issuer or payment-service provider.
processing.li1: Refunds for prepaid orders will generally be made through the original payment channel where technically and operationally possible.
processing.li2: Where the original payment channel cannot be used, Souviks may request verified bank-account or other payment details necessary to complete the refund securely.
processing.li3: Souviks will not request unnecessary payment credentials, passwords, PINs or one-time authentication codes for processing a refund.

payment_method.p1: Souviks may accept UPI, bank transfer, net banking, credit or debit cards, cash and cash on delivery, subject to the payment options available for the order.
payment_method.p2: For cash-on-delivery or other transactions where there is no original electronic payment channel available, Souviks may process an approved refund through a verified bank account or another appropriate method.

cancellation.p1: Where cancellation is available before dispatch, an eligible cancellation may result in a refund after verification and subject to the applicable payment and order conditions.
cancellation.p2: Cancellation is not permitted after dispatch. After dispatch, any eligible claim must be handled under the applicable return, exchange, refund or warranty process.

non_refundable.p1: Certain products and situations are not eligible for refunds under Souviks' standard policy, subject always to any mandatory rights provided by applicable law.
non_refundable.li2: Electrical and electronic products are subject to their specific return conditions and are eligible for refund only where the applicable conditions are satisfied.
non_refundable.li3: Products that have been installed, used, modified, dismantled, tampered with or returned with a broken applicable seal may be ineligible for a refund.

exceptions.p1: Nothing in this Refund Policy is intended to exclude, restrict or waive any consumer right, statutory remedy or other protection that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable Indian law. Where applicable law requires a refund, replacement or other remedy, Souviks will comply with that requirement.

contact.p1: For refund requests, refund status, or questions regarding an approved or pending refund, please contact Souviks.
